prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in League City, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1208; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine, we'll keep it focused. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was in a parking lot at a shopping center in League City, Texas. I was pulling out of a space near the front entrance.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I had my signal on and I was backing out slowly. I checked my mirror, but a pickup was coming down the aisle faster than I expected.
Q: How fast would you estimate the other vehicle was moving?
A: Honestly, it wasn't fast, maybe a brisk walking pace for a car in a lot. But I didn't see it until it was already close.
Q: Did you exchange information with the other driver?
A: Yes, we swapped insurance details and took a few photos of the bumpers.
Q: Did you notice any injuries at the scene?
A: My neck jerked forward and then back, and my lower back started aching within an hour or so. I didn't go to the ER, but I went to my doctor the next day.
Q: What symptoms are you still having?
A: Stiffness in the morning, a dull ache across my shoulders, and sitting for long periods bothers my lower back. I've been doing some stretching and taking over-the-counter pain relievers.
Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?
A: Nothing serious. I had some occasional soreness years ago from lifting at work, but it cleared up on its own.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Just that I'm willing to follow up with my doctor and provide the records. I want this taken care of properly.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
